site.title: International Competitiveness Est.
site.description: International Competitiveness Group, or simply ICE, is a group of companies consulting businesses in various fields. We focus on how our services can support our clients by anticipating their needs and developing innovative solutions. In all markets and sectors that we are active in, we aim to build our sustainable competitive advantage via creating trustful relationships with our clients and establishing win-win partnerships with our suppliers. To do so, we always believe that our relationships with the two ends of our business activities must be managed by adopting agile, effective, and efficient process model.
